snippet.textDisplay: This man is totally correct.. I have two brothers and I'm the middle son. My mom died 14 years ago and they both just walked away.. ..and I wasn't the one who lived right down the road. My mother was living in her home in Houston, Texas and I lived 2,000 miles away in Los Angeles, CA. She was in her early 70's when she got hit with dementia. Thank God she appointed me with Power of Attorney. I decided to move her to LA with me, but I was going thru some hard times and working as a musician.. I placed her in a home for the aging and she lived there for 3 years and I visited her twice a day until she died. I can go on and on, and even write a book about what I went thru. I took her remains back home to Houston where she's laid to rest. I took care of my mom for 7 years flying back and forth, and till this day my brothers have never said.. Thank you brother. She even died in my arms at the hospital and I feel great that I did what I had to do.. She had many signs that the end was coming, but I got prepared. Now, since I'm living alone in another state, I'm preparing for myself since I'm 62 now. Thank you Dr. Shah and I hope people watching this get prepared, because it's super hard..

snippet.textDisplay: I am the oldest, daughter, nurse, and cared for my parents for almost 3 yrs. They lived 800 miles from me. Not expecting a miraculous solution, just grumbling and venting.

snippet.textDisplay: This is fairly true, but different for me.  I'm 64 now and disabled for about 15 years and the oldest and always responsible one.  My parents moved far away after I got re-married and bought a house, and I was the one who took care of my Grandma when they left.  I was raising a child and working and going to finish my bachelors degree at night.  I hold a lot of resentment.  But now as my dad just turned 94 and my mom is in her mid 80's, I can't travel to visit them, although I'm called whenever there are medical questions.  My sister goes to visit them.  She and I are supposed to be co-executors of my parents estate, but IDK what's going to happen or if I'll even outlive my parents.  My brother is an addict who is mostly out of the picture, my sister and I have both gone no contact with him.
